prediction_time: current_close_time + 1 millisecond; closed 4-hour candle information only
doji_policy: Keep time axis and predictions; exclude exact next_open == next_close only from binary fitting/scoring. Probability is conditional on a non-doji target.
gap_policy: Never impute; next target must be exactly 14400000 milliseconds later. Causal features require contiguous history after gaps.
calibration: Sigmoid logistic on raw log-odds using the trailing 90 days before each test quarter, disjoint from base-model fit

splits.development: 2024, four chronological quarters, expanding history and quarterly refit
splits.selection: Lowest concatenated 2024 calibrated log loss among exactly the two preregistered models; freeze selection before evaluation
splits.evaluation: 2025, four chronological quarters, selected model only; fixed recipe refit using information available before each quarter
splits.purge: Training label_available_time < calibration_start; calibration label_available_time < test_start

trade_backtest: NOT_RUN: classification study; no orders, entry/exit simulation, funding, PF, MDD, or return claims
future_trade_cost_assumption_if_separate: User's prior 0.12% round-trip fee plus actual funding and execution slippage; not applied to classification scores
prior_study_protection: Do not access/alter existing FINAL_OOS, paused studies, WSL or automation
storage_context: Isolated cloud Linux workspace supplied for this conversation, not the user's Windows/WSL environment; verified free space > 10 GiB; no access to C: or D:
